about: NIT Tiruchirappalli began in 1964 as Regional Engineering College Tiruchirappalli, a joint venture of the central and Tamil Nadu governments, became an NIT with deemed-university status in 2003 and an Institution of National Importance in 2007. It is consistently the top-ranked NIT in NIRF, placing 9th in Engineering and 30th Overall in 2025. The 800-acre campus at Thuvakudi houses 17 departments, nine B.Tech programmes plus B.Arch, and roughly 7,500 students across UG, PG and doctoral levels, with a strong core-engineering tradition alongside its large CSE and ECE cohorts.

location.connectivityNote: The campus is at Thuvakudi on the Trichy-Thanjavur highway (NH 83) beside the BHEL township, about 17-22 km from Tiruchirappalli Junction and the central bus stand per the institute's own page; Thanjavur-bound buses take roughly 30 minutes. Trichy is a major Southern Railway junction and has an international airport with domestic and Gulf/Sri Lanka flights.
